item.title: Learn to spot IRS fraudsters this National Consumer Protection Week
item.description: A lot of personal information being exchanged during this tax season: W2s, paystubs and tax forms are being mailed, emailed, even texted back and forth. All of that information is a gold mine for hackers.

item.title: Congressman Dan Goldman, Brad Lander to square off in primary fight after SCOTUS decision
item.description: The Supreme Court's decision has clarified the path forward for Dan Goldman's re-election campaign for District 10, which is now focused squarely on fending off former City Comptroller Brad Lander's primary bid.

item.title: Bonobo lunges at guests, cracking glass enclosure at Memphis Zoo, shocking video shows
item.description: Wild video from the Memphis Zoo shows the moment an ape lunged at visitors, smashing a pane of glass in the enclosure.

item.title: WATCH: National Geographic's 'Secrets of the Bees' trailer from executive producer James Cameron
item.description: From executive producer James Cameron, National Geographic's "Secrets of the Bees" explores the world of bees with never-before-filmed moments.

item.title: Joan Lunden reflects on groundbreaking career, new book with former GMA colleague Bill Ritter
item.description: She sat down with our own Bill Ritter, her longtime co-worker, to talk all about it, including her advice for young people starting their careers in the news business and taking a trip down memory lane.

item.title: Pentagon IDs 4 American troops killed in Kuwait
item.description: The Pentagon on Tuesday identified four of the six American troops killed in the opening hours of the war with Iran.

item.title: The viral 'Luigi: The Musical' is coming to NYC this summer
item.description: The show, which sold out its San Francisco run, was inspired by the true story of inmates Luigi Mangione, Sean Diddy Combs and Sam Bankman-Fried sharing time at Brooklyn's Metropolitan Detention Center.

item.title: Couple from Teaneck stranded in Israel as they try to get back home amid Iran war
item.description: Joshua Lipowsky and Stephanie Hausner are describing their harrowing experience seeking shelter in an Israeli bomb shelter while they try to get home.

item.title: 75-year-old man slashed to death in dispute between neighbors in Astoria: sources
item.description: Police say George Dourdounas was found with a slashed neck inside his apartment building located at 25-75 33rd St. in Astoria around 1:40 p.m.

item.title: Ronald McDonald House hosts annual Skate With the Greats charity game at Chelsea Piers
item.description: For $2,000, you could skate alongside former New York Rangers hockey players at Chelsea Piers in New York City Tuesday night.
